list.title: Workspaces
list.description: Shared places for a team or a project.
list.emptyHint: A workspace holds the lists and libraries of a team or a project.
list.emptyAsk: Ask an administrator to create one or add you to one.

home.emptyHint: Lists hold rows of information such as contacts or budgets; libraries hold files.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.readOnly: Only workspace owners change these settings. You can look at them.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords used in this workspace. Choose one to see what carries it.

general.currencyHint: Leave empty to use the organization default. Applies when creating currency fields.
general.copyDescription: Export this workspace's configuration, with optional items and files, and import it into another PaperGo instance.
general.deleteDescription: Deletes the workspace with all its lists, libraries, folders, items and workflows.
general.confirmDescription: Everything in this workspace becomes unavailable to everyone, including its lists, libraries and workflows. This cannot be undone here.

owner.label: Owner
owner.hint: Manages the workspace, its members, lists and libraries

members.addDescription: People must be active users of the organization.
members.description: Owners manage the workspace; a workspace always keeps one owner.
members.removeSelf: You lose access to this workspace unless a group or another grant still gives it to you.
members.removeOther: They lose access given by workspace membership. Explicit grants on lists or items stay.

collection.permissionsDescription: By default everyone in the workspace has access by their workspace role. Folders and items can have their own permissions too.
collection.readOnlyLibrary: Only people who manage this library change its settings. You can look at them.
collection.readOnlyList: Only people who manage this list change its settings. You can look at them.

bin.title: Recycle bin
bin.description: Deleted items and folders of this list. Restore them, or delete them for good.
bin.purgeFolder: The folder and everything in it can no longer be restored.
bin.purgeItem: It can no longer be restored.

menu.deleteDescription: The collection and all its contents move to the recycle bin.

newCollection.title: New list or library
newCollection.description: Lists hold rows of information; libraries hold files. Columns and views can be changed later.
newCollection.blankListHint: Rows with a title; add your own columns.
newCollection.blankLibraryHint: Files with a name; add your own columns.
